description: Full retirement of an EKS cluster that is being decommissioned. Must: drain all workloads (gracefully evict pods with PDB respect), verify no critical workloads remain, export any needed data/configs, terraform destroy the cluster infrastructure, purge secrets from Vault, clean up cross-account IAM roles and peering connections, and verify DNS records are removed. Risk factors: missed workloads still running, Vault secrets not purged causing security exposure, orphaned EBS volumes incurring costs, cross-account access still active after deletion. Tools available: kubectl, terraform, aws CLI, Vault, ansible.
